body:
I noticed my reflection in the calm surface of the sea, distorted and shimmering like a piece of ancient art. My heart raced as I realized I might be witnessing something extraordinary—some kind of supernatural phenomenon or even an underwater anomaly. Without thinking, my eyes widened, and I stepped closer to inspect the strange circles on the ocean floor more closely. 

My mind was racing with theories: could these marks be part of some secret structure beneath the waves? Or were they somehow connected to the mysterious disappearances off this coast? With every passing second, a sense of urgency gripped me—the more curious I became about what lay just below the waters’ edge, the less time there seemed for any confrontation.
